About Ruchi Realty

Built around quality, clarity and long term relationships.

Since 2008, Ruchi Realty has created residential, commercial and plotted developments across Kolkata, Indore and Bhopal.

Our work brings together considered locations, practical planning, responsible construction and support that continues beyond possession.

Our story and leadership →
What buyers can expect

Clear commitments
at every stage.

A property decision should be based on information that can be checked. These are the standards we aim to make visible across every project.

Plans, specifications, approvals and RERA information, where applicable, should be easy to review before a site visit.

Materials, fittings and finishes should be presented in plain language and matched to approved project documents.

A handover is not the end of the relationship. Buyers should know whom to contact and how support is handled.

Milestones and material changes should be communicated clearly, without making buyers chase information.

Projects should explain real connectivity to work, education, healthcare and essential services.
